## Summary

> proper (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circle). Radius is non-negative.

```plato
//==
// # Circles and circle-derived planar regions
//
// The disk and the regions cut from or swept around it: the annulus between two
// concentric circles, the pie-slice sector, the chord-bounded segment, and the
// stadium traced by sweeping a disk along a segment. Angles are measured from +X,
// counter-clockwise; winding convention: counter-clockwise is positive.

// The disk of all points within Radius of Center; its boundary is the circle
// proper (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circle). Radius is non-negative.
type Circle
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentered2D, IContainsPoint2D, INearestPoint2D, ISupport2D
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Radius: Number;
}
```
